nodes.label: Auth Session API
nodes.rationale: Returns session metadata, including impersonation context if active.

nodes.label: WebAuthn Passkey Exists API
nodes.rationale: Lightweight pre-auth check for enrolled WebAuthn credentials to drive UI logic.

nodes.label: Public Portfolio API
nodes.rationale: Returns public portfolio profile including QR code; checks restriction status.

nodes.label: Restrict Client API
nodes.rationale: Restricts a client account for a specific duration with a reason.

nodes.label: Unrestrict Client API
nodes.rationale: Removes active restriction and clears restriction metadata.

nodes.label: Restrict Company API
nodes.rationale: Permanently restricts a company and suspends all associated accounts in a single transaction.

nodes.label: Start Superadmin Impersonation API
nodes.rationale: Starts superadmin impersonation of a target user, setting an httpOnly cookie and requiring CSRF.

nodes.label: Database Reconcile Fix API
nodes.rationale: Compares and fixes missing User.company_id links based on legacy SQL data.

nodes.label: Create Staff API
nodes.rationale: Creates a new staff member in invited state and sends a verification email.

nodes.label: Broadcast Notification API
nodes.rationale: Broadcasts system_update notifications to all active users based on preferences.

nodes.label: EventAttendance
nodes.rationale: Proposed entity for recording physical presence at an event with unique constraints on user and event.

nodes.label: ManagedEvent
nodes.rationale: Proposed entity for company-owned venue events, separate from user-owned CalendarEvents.

nodes.label: NetworkingProfile
nodes.rationale: Proposed entity for member-only networking metadata, intent, and privacy settings.

nodes.label: Attendance & Event Monitoring
nodes.rationale: Architecture blueprint for a company-owned managed event domain with NFC/QR check-in.

nodes.label: Networking Profiles for Members
nodes.rationale: Detailed blueprint for a professional networking layer extending the existing Associates system.

nodes.label: Merge Bizcard
nodes.rationale: Atomically deletes blank inventory row and attaches serial_id to user's virtual card.

nodes.label: Portfolio URI Resolver
nodes.rationale: Serial-first logic for frontend redirect orchestration.

nodes.label: Generate Blank Bizcards
nodes.rationale: Bulk generation of physical cards with unique serial IDs and is_blank: true.

nodes.label: Dashboard Overview
nodes.rationale: Returns summary metrics and widgets. Queries run in parallel for minimal latency.

nodes.label: Record Contact Save
nodes.rationale: Increments metrics.totalContactSaves on GET /api/dashboard for the portfolio owner.

nodes.label: Track Portfolio View
nodes.rationale: Increments metrics.totalViews on GET /api/dashboard for the portfolio owner.

nodes.label: Shop Commission Model
nodes.rationale: Handles affiliate commission logic and idempotency.

nodes.label: Create Company
nodes.rationale: In-app upgrade path. Sets user role to company_admin and assigns company_id.

nodes.label: Subscription Model
nodes.rationale: Manages access tiers (Basic, Standard, Premium, Enterprise) and free trials.

nodes.label: Request Signed Upload Params
nodes.rationale: Generates R2 presigned URL for direct browser upload of large files (videos).

nodes.label: Upload Media (Proxied)
nodes.rationale: Proxies small files to R2. Vercel payload limit ≈ 4.5 MB.

nodes.label: Update User Theme
nodes.rationale: Persists selection in bizcard.bizcard_theme. Invalidates public profile cache.

nodes.label: vCard Details (Modular)
nodes.rationale: Modularized for parallel loading and cache isolation.

nodes.label: Membership
nodes.rationale: Proposed unifying domain for platform access, renewals, and lifetime NFC card status.

nodes.label: Feature Integration Recommendations
nodes.rationale: Strategic roadmap for unifying membership, events, tokens, and networking under a Membership domain.

nodes.label: Process Email Queue
nodes.rationale: Drains NotificationEmailQueue. Batch size controlled by EMAIL_QUEUE_BATCH_SIZE.

nodes.label: Activity Feed
nodes.rationale: Paginated list of events: views, connections, inquiries, contact saves, and card scans.

nodes.label: vCard Completion Score
nodes.rationale: Calculates percentage based on Basic, Contact, Identity, and Content field groups.

nodes.label: API Documentation Overview
nodes.rationale: Central documentation for the ONTAP Authentication Backend and related services.

nodes.label: Portfolio Analytics
nodes.rationale: Returns aggregated engagement statistics scoped strictly to the calling user.

nodes.label: Send Connection Request
nodes.rationale: Requires session_token cookie. Dispatches friend_request_sent notification and email.

nodes.label: Submit Visitor Inquiry
nodes.rationale: Stores inquiry with status 'new' and read_flag: false.
